svg.title: Figure 3-SG-07-2. SG-07: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-07-2. SG-07: 21 events (backed 15, by design 1, external 1, unbacked 4); 22 FMEA modes reach SG-07 (in the tree 18, justified 2, tree gaps 2). BE-7.20 ((diagnostic TX hook passes any ISO 15765 frame; as SG-07)): No FMEA row needed: by design; The ELM327 TX hook passes any ISO 15765 frame by design (SWF-015.C1); it is the standing condition under which BE-7.21 acts. BE-7.21 (SoC sends a diagnostic request that resets or opens a session on the stock camera or radar while driving (QM fault)) → SWF-015: Diagnostic (ELM327) mode accepted while driving; worst cause SWF-015.C1 (ELM327 TX hook allows any ISO 15765 diagnostic frame with no service, ignition or motion condition. BL-005, reference build (default): once TOYOTA has been accepted with the ignition on, ELM327 is refused until the ignition goes off (panda#16, LD-DES-001 DR-05, DFA DFI-13c). Before the car mode in each ignition cycle (fingerprinting, radar disable), or for a whole drive in which the car mode is never set, the content is still unrestricted; O 4, D 8, AP H); detection: panda host tests test_elm327_refused_after_the_car_mode_while_ignition_on, test_elm327_allowed_again_after_ignition_off and test_refused_elm327_counted, run in CI (safety.yaml panda_host_tests). Targeted at the gate, not proven by mutation; nothing tests frame content BE-7.13 (Item sends a positive ACC request during a PCS event (stand-down missing or defective; opendbc caps 0x343 at 0 from the first frame)) → SFM-036, SWF-093: Item keeps requesting acceleration while stock PCS brakes; worst cause SFM-036.C2 (The PCM does not give stock PCS braking priority over the item's ACC_CONTROL request (AOU-04R not met); O 3, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause; AOU-04R needs a message review and a PCS target test (WP-C-04) UE-7.14 (PCM arbitration does not prioritise PCS (AOU-04R fails)): No FMEA row needed: external; AOU-04R
